en.title: Why an AI LaTeX Editor Should Start with the PDF
en.description: Why Overleaf and Prism's source-centered interaction model is outdated for AI scientific writing, and why Papilot gives the workspace exclusively to the rendered PDF.
en.lead: Overleaf and Prism still give prime screen space to source editing. In AI-assisted writing, authors should direct and judge revisions on the rendered manuscript—not inside a code pane.
en.heroAlt: Papilot product illustration showing a typeset before-and-after change with Accept, Reject and Comment controls.
en.heroCaption: Review the change as your readers will see it: on the typeset page.

zh-CN.title: 为什么 AI LaTeX 编辑器应该从 PDF 出发
zh-CN.description: 为什么 Overleaf 与 Prism 以源码为中心的交互模式已经落伍？介绍 Papilot 如何将工作空间彻底交还给排版后的 PDF 页面。
zh-CN.lead: Overleaf 和 Prism 依旧把主要空间留给源代码。在 AI 辅助写作时代，作者应当直接在排版成稿上指明意图、审阅结果，而不是被困在代码窗格里。
zh-CN.heroAlt: Papilot 产品示意图：排版后的修改前后对比，以及接受、拒绝和评论操作。
zh-CN.heroCaption: 在排版后的页面上审阅改动，看到读者会看到的结果。
